digest.component_or_area: alert_store and binding snapshot commit paths
propositions: alert_store._atomic_write hand-rolls tempfile+os.replace instead of shared fsutil.atomic_write seam, creating parity gap with projects_store
alert_store writes to local-scratch bridge_state/bridge_alerts (gitignored, not tracked on tickets branch), so fsutil.atomic_write alone is correct without commit/publish path
converting alert_store to fsutil.atomic_write requires retained parent.mkdir call and preservation of 0o600 mode and fsync-before-replace durability

binding-snapshot conversion to push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch was attempted but reverted because git add -A sweeps in .bridge_state/last-pass.json, causing redundant commits and breaking reconcile idempotency on unchanged passes
binding-snapshot path must keep raw selective 5-file staging (not seam conversion) to maintain idempotency contract
